Metadata.title: Sufra | Your restaurant's website, ready in minutes
Metadata.description: Sufra lets any restaurant build its own website in minutes: a QR menu, table bookings and an easy dashboard.

Site.name: Sufra
Site.footerTagline: Your restaurant's website, ready in minutes: a QR menu, table bookings and an easy dashboard.

Home.title: Your restaurant's website, ready in minutes
Home.lead: A QR menu that opens on your guests' phones, table bookings without phone calls, and a dashboard where you change everything yourself.

NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.heading: We couldn't find that page
NotFound.body: The link may have a typo, or the page was removed.

Restaurant.bookBody: Online booking is coming soon. Until then, give us a call and we'll set up your table.
Restaurant.notFoundBody: Check the link, or ask the restaurant for its correct website address.
Restaurant.errorBody: We couldn't show this page right now. Please try again in a moment.

Dish.notFoundHeading: This dish isn't on the menu
Dish.notFoundBody: The restaurant may have removed it, or the link has a typo.

Auth.signInLead: and get back to your restaurant's site.
Auth.signUpLead: and set up your restaurant's site in minutes.
Auth.name: Your name
Auth.forgotLead: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to choose a new one.
Auth.forgotSent: If that email has an account, a link is on its way. It works for one hour.
Auth.resetLead: Once it's saved, you'll be signed out on every other device.
Auth.verifyLead: We sent you a confirmation link. Open it from your inbox to get into your dashboard.
Auth.verifyHint: Not there? Check your spam folder, or send it again.
Auth.verifyNoSession: Confirmed on another device? Sign in here.
Auth.resent: A new link is on its way. Older links no longer work.
Auth.confirmLead: Press the button to confirm your email and open your dashboard.

errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
errors.slugFormat: 3 to 40 characters: lowercase letters, numbers and dashes
errors.slugReserved: That address is reserved, pick another
errors.slugTaken: That address is taken, pick another
errors.signedOut: Your session ended, please sign in again
errors.notFound: This restaurant doesn't exist or isn't yours
errors.generic: Something went wrong, please try again
errors.priceInvalid: Enter the price in riyals, like 45 or 45.50
errors.conflict: The menu changed somewhere else. Refresh and try again.
errors.stale: This page is out of date. Refresh and try again.
errors.linkInvalid: This link has expired or was already used.

Dashboard.title: Dashboard
Dashboard.emptyBody: Set up your first restaurant site in minutes: a name, an address and your color.
Dashboard.categories: {count, plural, =0 {No sections} one {# section} other {# sections}}
Dashboard.createLead: This shows on your restaurant's site. You can change it later in settings.

fields.name: Restaurant name
fields.slugHint: Shown in the link after <path>/r/</path>. It can't change once the restaurant exists.
fields.timesHint: Riyadh time. If you close after midnight, just enter the time.
fields.accentHint: Your whole site's colors come from it, with contrast adjusted for you.

MenuEditor.title: Menu
MenuEditor.lead: Reorder sections and dishes by dragging, or with the keyboard: Space to pick up, arrows to move.
MenuEditor.empty: The menu is empty. Start with a first section, like “Mains”.
MenuEditor.confirmCategory: Delete the “{name}” section? {count, plural, =0 {It has no dishes.} one {Its # dish goes too.} other {Its # dishes go too.}}

dnd.instructions: Press Space or Enter to pick up. Move with the arrow keys, then press Space or Enter to drop, or Escape to cancel.

Email.footer: Sufra · a website for every restaurant

verify.subject: Confirm your email for Sufra
verify.preheader: One more step and you can set up your restaurant's site.
verify.heading: Hi {name}, one more step
verify.body: Press the button to confirm your email and start setting up your restaurant's site.

reset.subject: Reset your Sufra password
reset.preheader: A link to choose a new password.
reset.heading: Reset your password
reset.body: We got a request to reset the password for your account. If it was you, press the button and choose a new one.
reset.expires: This link works once, for one hour.

exists.subject: You already have a Sufra account
exists.preheader: Someone tried to sign up with your email.
exists.heading: You already have an account
exists.body: Someone tried to create a new account with this email, but it already has one. You can sign in now, or choose a new password if you've forgotten it.
